headline: Gutter Line Swings Again as Olavis Wake and Pari Peak Erupt
war_summary: The Gutter has changed hands once more. Where the last edition found five works Warden and but one Colonial, the latest returns show three Colonial, two Warden and two unclaimed, with seven actions in the past two hours and eighty-three in the day around Kuoppa and The Parras. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's great furnace: fifty actions in the day and six in the past two hours, its works now standing four Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed at Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Fresh fighting has broken out in the east. Olavis Wake reports eight actions in the past two hours — its entire day's tally — with 1,465 Colonial and 1,436 Warden casualties in that brief span, the sharpest bloodletting on the map. Pari Peak likewise shows six actions in two hours, with the heaviest counts at Pariah and Iltaku, while Stlican Shelf's Breaker Town adds eleven actions in the day. Elsewhere the lines have gone quiet: the Nevish Line and Marban Hollow, both busy overnight, report but three and one actions in the past six hours. Callahans Passage again bears the heaviest toll — 8,658 Colonial and 6,530 Warden in the day — without a work changing hands. Colonials hold 307 works to 119 Warden, ten unclaimed.
